payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes binomial coefficients and uses DP to count surjections (i^n minus those with fewer colors) then combines combinatorially to count valid colorings.
payload.rationale: Solution uses DP recurrence F[i] = i^n - sum_{j<i} F[j] * C(i,j) to count ways to use exactly i colors on n cells, then evaluates a combinatorial sum over partitions of colors, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics.
